name: G6 T3 W05 - Online Safety - 6A and 6B
description: Practise safe choices in online chats. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once each this week. This is formative practice.

words.definition: Keeping personal information under your control.
words.example: I protect my privacy by keeping my home address out of the chat.

words.definition: A limit you set about what you are willing to do or share.
words.example: My boundary is that I do not share my password.

words.definition: An attempt to make someone do something they do not want to do.
words.example: I feel pressure when a player says I must send a photo to stay on the team.

words.definition: An agreement that allows someone to do something.
words.example: I ask for permission before posting my friend's photo.

words.definition: Tell the platform about harmful behaviour so it can review it.
words.example: I report a harmful message using the app's safety button.
